modelcontextprotocol-registry.name: v1.8.14
modelcontextprotocol-registry.body:
## What's Changed
* Promote registry v1.8.13 to production by @rdimitrov in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/registry/pull/1897
* Run the staging malware sweep on demand by @rdimitrov in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/registry/pull/1899
* Fix moderation guidance, warning event counts, and idle-day collection by @rdimitrov in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/registry/pull/1900


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/registry/compare/v1.8.13...v1.8.14

modelcontextprotocol-registry.name: v1.8.15
modelcontextprotocol-registry.body:
## What's Changed
* Use imageTag alone with the next production release by @rdimitrov in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/registry/pull/1901
* Confirm missing packages before sending sweep findings by @rdimitrov in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/registry/pull/1902


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/registry/compare/v1.8.14...v1.8.15

modelcontextprotocol-registry.name: v1.8.16
modelcontextprotocol-registry.body:
## What's Changed
* Promote registry v1.8.15 to production by @rdimitrov in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/registry/pull/1904
* Reduce database work during edits and skip documentation-only staging deploys by @rdimitrov in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/registry/pull/1908
* Separate the usage collector and backup identities in stages by @rdimitrov in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/registry/pull/1909
* Preserve moderator holds on withdrawn server versions by @rdimitrov in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/registry/pull/1910


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/registry/compare/v1.8.15...v1.8.16
